remaining: Contextual addressability, relative social status and appropriate politeness cannot be established from noun POS alone.
Existing nominalization, outer particle and copula composition may generate additional hypotheses; no source disposition here certifies all such combinations.
Non-Hangul final pronunciation remains conditional, and the noun/other-POS dictionary homonym choice remains contextual.
Homonymous 야 emphasis and 아/여 predicate/copular forms retain existing behavior; this batch does not select a sentence interpretation. Independent Korean-language review remains pending.
Raw additions include unjudged alternative bases such as 젊은 + 이여 for 젊은이여 and 보다 + 음 + 이여 for 봄이여. The report preserves these hypotheses without claiming contextual precision.
